methods.label: Use complementary acute angles
methods.explanation: The two acute angles of a right triangle are complementary, so the other acute angle is \(90^\circ-35^\circ=55^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: Directly applies the grade 8 right-triangle complementary-angle property.
